meta.heading: SUNSHINE COAST FISHING CALENDAR
meta.subtitle: Buddina Canal Base • Mooloolaba Harbour • Sunshine Coast Offshore (0–15 NM)

species.name: Mangrove Jack
species.rodReel: 3000-4000 Spin or Baitcaster, 6-10kg heavy fast-action rod
species.rig: Snag-rigged weedless swimbait or unweighted live poddy mullet pinned through nose
species.baits: Live poddy mullet, live canal herring, 3"-4" paddle-tail soft plastics, deep diving hardbodies
species.spots: Buddina/Minyama Pontoon Pylons: Skip cast deep into shadow lines of private pontoons during run-out tide. Kawana Waters Weir: Cast downstream turbulence on dusk/night tides.
species.tip: A 5.2m boat creates hull slap against canal revetment walls. Keep the electric motor at low speed and cast tight into shadow lines.

species.name: Dusky Flathead
species.lineLeader: 8-10 lb Braid + 12-14 lb Fluorocarbon (abrasion resistant for sharp jaw plates)
species.rig: 1/4 oz to 3/8 oz jighead with 3/0 hook, or rolling unweighted strip bait across sandbars
species.baits: 3"-4" paddle tails in motor oil or bloodworm colors, whitebait, peeled local prawns
species.spots: Mooloolah River Sandbars & Drop-offs: Work edges near river mouth and La Balsa Park during run-out tide. Buddina Canal Junctions: Tributary drains emptying over flats.
species.tip: Anchor the Sea Spirit 520 upwind of the sand spit drop-off and fan-cast across current seams with soft plastics.

species.name: Yellowfin Bream
species.rig: Unweighted or lightly weighted #1 hook, or 1/16 oz hidden weight jighead
species.baits: Live glass shrimp, fresh yabbies pumped at La Balsa flats, small crab pieces, 2.5" grub plastics
species.spots: Minyama Island & Buddina Mooring Piles: Barnacle encrusted pylons. Mooloolaba Boat Ramp Rock Walls: Fished along current wash.
species.tip: Use minimal weight. Let your bait drift down naturally through pontoon shadow lines on the first 2 hours of the run-in tide.

species.name: Sand Whiting
species.lineLeader: 6 lb Braid + 6 lb Fluorocarbon with red attractor bead
species.rig: Running sinker rig with #6 longshank hook and 60cm fluorocarbon trace
species.baits: Live bloodworms, live beach worms, freshly pumped live yabbies
species.spots: La Balsa Park Sand Flats: Shallows near the river mouth. Currimundi Lake & Kawana Canals: Clean sandy flats with good tidal flow.
species.tip: Keep the boat in deeper canal channels and cast onto shallow sand edges as the tide rises over the sand banks.

species.name: Giant Trevally (GT)
species.rig: Surface poppers, walk-the-dog stickbaits, or live canal mullet on a sturdy circle hook
species.baits: Surface poppers (60-90mm), metal slugs, live poddy mullet or garfish
species.spots: Kawana Waters Lock / Weir: Aggressive canal runs at dawn. Mooloolah River Main Channel: Current junctions and pontoon points.
species.tip: Lock your drag down; canal GTs will run straight around mooring ropes and pontoons within seconds.

species.name: Golden Trevally
species.rig: 1/4 oz jighead with 3" shrimp soft plastic or running sinker rig with live prawn
species.baits: Live prawns, live yabbies, small crabs, Berkley Gulp shrimp plastics
species.spots: Mooloolah River Lower Channel: Sand/mud flats near La Balsa. Kawana Canal Bridges: Deep bridge pylon eddies.
species.tip: Look for feeding rings where they root their rubbery lips into the canal mud hunting for crabs and mantis shrimp.

species.name: Bigeye Trevally
species.rig: Small poppers, sinking twitchbaits, or 2.5" paddle-tail soft plastics
species.baits: Live canal herring, micro metal slices, surface minnows
species.spots: Minyama Artificial Lights: Pontoons with underwater green or amber lights at night. Kawana Bridge Pylons: Tidal eddy seams.
species.tip: Highly nocturnal canal hunters. Fish the illuminated canal pontoons around midnight on a running tide.

species.name: Goldspotted Rockcod (Estuary Cod)
species.rig: Heavy running sinker rig or weedless weighted swimbait
species.baits: Live poddy mullet, live yellowtail pike, fresh squid, large soft plastics
species.spots: Deep Canal Caverns: Deepest dredged holes (6m+) in Minyama and Buddina. Mooloolaba Harbour Rock Walls: Deep boulder base.
species.tip: Cod grab bait and head straight back into the rock cavity or pontoon pipes. Strike hard and horse them away immediately.

species.name: Tarwhine
species.rig: Running pea sinker to size #2 hook or light unweighted bait
species.baits: Peeled prawns, yabbies, bread dough, small clam pieces
species.spots: Mooloolaba Breakwall Wash: Sand pockets between rocks. La Balsa Park Channel.
species.tip: Often school alongside yellowfin bream in the cooler winter months; they fight harder pound-for-pound than bream.

species.name: Luderick (Blackfish)
species.lineLeader: 6-8 lb Braid or Mono + 6 lb Fluorocarbon trace
species.rig: Weighted stem float with split shot chain down to #8-10 short-shank blackfish hook
species.baits: Fresh green ribbon weed / cabbage weed, peeled prawn pieces, bread paste
species.spots: Mooloolaba Harbour Rock Walls & Groynes: Run-out tide eddies along weed-covered boulders. Buddina/Minyama Canal Pontoons: Shaded pylons.
species.tip: Mix chopped green weed with wet sand as berley and adjust float depth until your bait drifts just above the weed line.

species.name: Giant Herring
species.lineLeader: 10-12 lb Braid + 15-20 lb Fluorocarbon (abrasion resistant for raspy jaws)
species.rig: 3" jerkshad on 1/6 oz jighead, surface walk-the-dog lure, or live canal herring
species.baits: Live canal herring, 3" white soft plastics, small sinking minnows
species.spots: Kawana Waters Weir & Canal Bridges: Current seams at dawn and dusk. Minyama Illuminated Pontoons: Shadow edges at night.
species.tip: Expect explosive aerial leaps and blistering runs. Keep your rod tip low when they jump to prevent throwing the hook.

species.name: Oxeye Herring (Tarpon)
species.rig: 1/12 oz jighead with 2" paddle tail, micro crankbait, or unweighted live glass shrimp
species.baits: Live glass shrimp, 2" minnow plastics, micro surface poppers
species.spots: Buddina Dead-End Canal Basins: Warm surface water during summer evenings. Kawana Canal Bridges: Light lines after dark.
species.tip: They have bony mouths; use sharp, fine-wire hooks and keep steady pressure through acrobatic jumps.

species.name: King Threadfin (Threadfin Salmon)
species.rig: 3/8 oz jighead with 4" prawn/paddle-tail plastic or live prawn on running sinker rig
species.baits: Live banana prawns, live poddy mullet, 4" soft prawn imitations, vibration blades
species.spots: Lower Mooloolah River Deep Bends: Muddy drop-offs and scour holes. Minyama Canal Junctions: Turn of tide after summer rains.
species.tip: Scan deep canal holes with side-scan sonar; threadfin sit tight to the bottom and respond well to hopped soft vibes.

species.name: Barramundi
species.closure: ⚠️ QLD East Coast Closed Season: 1 November to 31 January annually (no targeting)
species.rig: 4"-5" weedless paddle-tail swimbait or suspending hardbody minnow
species.baits: Live poddy mullet, live prawns, 100-120mm suspending minnows, 4"-5" paddle tails
species.spots: Upper Mooloolah River Snags & Rock Bars: Fallen timber and deep bends. Kawana Weir Outflow: Warm post-rain runoff.
species.tip: Opportunistic warm-water visitor in the Mooloolah system; focus on February and March right after the seasonal closure lifts.

species.name: Australian Bass
species.closure: ⚠️ QLD Tidal Waters Closed Season: 1 June to 31 August annually
species.rig: Surface cicada/popper at dawn, or 1/8 oz jighead with 2.5" grub tight to timber
species.baits: Surface walker lures, diving crankbaits, 2.5" curl-tail plastics, live garden worms
species.spots: Upper Mooloolah River Brackish & Freshwater Reaches: Upstream of the Mooloolah River bridges around shaded snags and undercut banks.
species.tip: Idle the Sea Spirit 520 quietly upstream on a high tide to access upper river timber; cast tight into shaded pockets.

species.name: Mud Crab
species.sizeLimit: Min: 15 cm carapace width. MALES ONLY (Females strictly protected)
species.rodReel: Heavy crab pots with legal tags (Name, address, phone number)
species.lineLeader: Heavy lead-core rope + approved regulation floats
species.rig: Heavy gauge square or round mesh pot with secure bait pouches
species.baits: Fresh mullet carcasses, chicken frames, fish heads
species.spots: Buddina Back Canals & Drains: Deep mud recesses and mangrove junctions. Upper Mooloolah River: Mud banks past Mountain Creek bridge.
species.tip: Set pots ahead of the high tide in deep holes, checking them on the early outgoing tide. Keep pots clear of navigation channels.

species.name: Blue Swimmer Crab (Sand Crab)
species.sizeLimit: Min: 11.5 cm carapace width. MALES ONLY
species.bagLimit: Combined limit of 20 crabs per person
species.rodReel: Witches hats or crab dillies / crab pots
species.lineLeader: Lead-core rope with compliant marked floats
species.rig: Collapsible crab pots with bait bag secured in center
species.baits: Fresh fish frames, pilchards, mullet pieces
species.spots: Mooloolaba Harbour Entrance & Bay: Clean sand grounds inside Point Cartwright. Lower Mooloolah River mouth channels.
species.tip: Unlike mud crabs, sand crabs prefer clean sandy substrate with clear tidal water. Check dillies every 30-45 minutes.

species.name: Diamondscale Mullet
species.rodReel: 2000 Light Spin with sensitive float, 1-3kg rod
species.rig: Waggler float rig with #10-12 fine wire nymph hook
species.baits: White bread dough, bread paste, soaked bread flake
species.spots: Buddina Canal dead-ends: Warm surface waters during calm afternoons. Kawana Waters weir edges.
species.tip: Ground-bait with bread crumbs first to bring them to the surface, then suspend a bread dough pellet 30cm under a float.

species.name: Mulloway (Jewfish)
species.rig: Running sinker rig to 6/0-8/0 circle hook or 1oz 7" paddle-tail soft plastic
species.baits: Live slimy mackerel, fresh squid strips, live mullet, 6" paddle-tail swimbaits
species.spots: Mooloolaba Harbour River Entrance: Deep scour hole by harbour rock groynes. Minyama Deep Channel Holes: Turn of high tide at night.
species.tip: Slack tide on new and full moon nights is prime. Drift your live bait right near the bottom.

species.name: Tailor
species.lineLeader: 15-20 lb Braid + 30-40 lb Monofilament trace (or wire trace if bite-offs occur)
species.rig: Gang hook rig (3x 4/0 gangs) unweighted or with small pea sinker
species.baits: Whole WA pilchard, metal casting spoons (20g-40g), surface poppers
species.spots: Point Cartwright Headland: Casting into the wash around headland. Mooloolaba Harbour Breakwalls: Dawn and dusk feeding schools.
species.tip: Keep an eye out for bird diving action outside Point Cartwright during winter dawns.

species.name: Tiger Squid & Calamari
species.rodReel: 2500 EGI Spin rod (soft, whippy tip for parabolic flex)
species.rig: Egi Squid Jig sizes 2.5 to 3.5 (Pink, Orange, Rainbow base, UV glow)
species.baits: Yamashita or Yo-Zuri squid jigs in natural prawn or bright orange/pink foils
species.spots: Point Cartwright Kelp Grounds: Drift clean weed beds inside the point. Mooloolaba River Training Walls: High tide crystal clear water.
species.tip: Clean, clear water is essential. If recent heavy rain dirtied the canal, head out towards Point Cartwright kelp lines.

species.name: Arrow Squid
species.rig: Heavy luminous squid jig (size 3.5 to 4.0) or weighted squid spike with whole pilchard
species.baits: Luminous glowing jigs, whole pilchard pinned on wire squid spear
species.spots: Mooloolaba Bay Shallows: 10-18m water off Point Cartwright at night. Inner Gneerings fringe.
species.tip: Turn on the Sea Spirit's transom flood lights or underwater LEDs at night to aggregate bait schools and arrow squid.

species.name: School Mackerel (Doggie)
species.lineLeader: 15-20 lb Braid + 30 lb Fluorocarbon with small wire bite trace
species.rig: Floating pilchard on triple 3/0 ganged hooks, or high-speed spinning metals
species.baits: Whole WA pilchard, metal slugs, live herring
species.spots: Mooloolaba Harbour Entrance: Just past river mouth bar. Bray Rock & Currimundi: 10m-15m inshore lines.
species.tip: Anchor the Sea Spirit 520 near harbour mouth beacons and run a steady berley trail with chopped pilchards.

species.name: Grey Mackerel (Broad-barred)
species.lineLeader: 20 lb Braid + 40 lb Fluorocarbon + short 38 lb single-strand wire trace
species.rig: Floating whole pilchard on 4/0 ganged hooks, or 30-45g chrome casting slug
species.baits: Whole WA pilchard, live yellowtail scad, 35g metal slugs, bibbed minnows
species.spots: Point Cartwright & Mooloolaba Bay: Bait schools in 12-20m water. Old Woman Island & Inner Gneerings: Reef edges.
species.tip: Grey mackerel often sit slightly deeper than spotted mackerel; let your metal slug sink halfway to the bottom before burning it back.

species.name: Talang Queenfish
species.rig: Surface poppers skipped fast across waves, or live herring under a float
species.baits: Rooster poppers, chrome slices, live herring, live poddy mullet
species.spots: Point Cartwright Wave Wash: Where oceanic swell hits the river mouth training wall. Mooloolaba Harbour Entrance.
species.tip: High speed retrieve is non-negotiable. If they track your lure without striking, double your crank speed.

species.name: Australian Bonito
species.rig: Small chrome spoon (15g-30g) or shallow running hardbody minnow
species.baits: Small metal slices, whitebait flies, trolled shallow diving lures
species.spots: Mudjimba Island (Old Woman): Inshore wash. Point Cartwright Lighthouse Cliff Wash: 10-15m depth.
species.tip: Bleed immediately if intended for the table, or ice down whole as unbeatable offshore strip bait for Snapper and Pearl Perch.

species.name: Silver Trevally (Skippy)
species.rig: Light running sinker or 1/8 oz jighead with 2.5" curl tail grub
species.baits: Peeled prawn pieces, squid strips, whitebait, soft plastic grubs
species.spots: Mooloolaba Breakwall Base: Wash zones on clean winter tides. Inner Bray Rock reefs.
species.tip: They have soft mouths; back your drag off a notch during the fight to prevent hook pullouts.

species.name: Winter / Trumpeter Whiting (Diver)
species.rig: Two-hook dropper paternoster rig with #6-8 longshank hooks and red tubing
species.baits: Peeled prawn pieces, live bloodworms, squid strips, yabbies
species.spots: Mooloolaba Harbour Entrance Sand Grounds: 10-18m clean sand flats. Currimundi Nearshore Grounds: Driftable sand patches.
species.tip: Run a slow drift over clean sand outside the harbour entrance; drop sand crab dillies along the same drift line.

species.name: Blackall (Painted Sweetlip)
species.rig: Running ball sinker rig to 3/0-4/0 suicide hook or 3/8 oz jighead
species.baits: Peeled prawns, squid strips, pilchard pieces, 4" soft plastics
species.spots: Mooloolaba Breakwalls & Point Cartwright Wash: Boulder edges. Inner Gneerings & Bray Rock: Shallow reef ledges.
species.tip: Strong, dogged fighters on light gear; bleed immediately on capture for clean white fillets.

species.name: Swallowtail Dart
species.rig: Light running ball sinker to #1/0 hook, or 15-20g chrome metal slug
species.baits: Pipis, peeled prawns, beach worms, small chrome slugs
species.spots: Point Cartwright Whitewater Wash: Outside the surf zone on calm swells. Mooloolaba Spit Surf Edge: Outer sandbars.
species.tip: Hold the Sea Spirit 520 safely outside the break line and cast into whitewater gutters on a rising tide.

species.name: Snapper (Squire)
species.closure: ⚠️ QLD Snapper/Pearl Perch Closure: 15 July to 15 August annually
species.rig: Lightly weighted strayline rig, or 1/4 to 1/2 oz jighead with 5"-7" jerkshads
species.baits: Whole fresh WA pilchard floated down a berley trail, fresh squid, 5"-7" ZMan jerkshads
species.spots: Murphy's Reef: Gravel patches and ledges. Inner & Outer Gneerings: High relief bommies at first light. Caloundra 12 Mile: Southern deep grounds.
species.tip: In a 5.2m boat, pick mornings with under 10 knot winds and under 1.2m swell. Drift the drop-offs with minimal lead.

species.name: Pearl Perch
species.closure: ⚠️ QLD Snapper/Pearl Perch Closure: 15 July to 15 August annually
species.rodReel: 30-50 lb Overhead or Slow Jigging Combo
species.rig: Double dropper paternoster rig with heavy sinker or 100g-150g slow pitch jig
species.baits: Fresh squid tentacles, live yakkas, strip of bonito or slimy mackerel
species.spots: Caloundra 12 Mile: 40m-60m depth wire weed and reef ledges. Outer Gneerings Deep Rubble: 35m-50m contour line.
species.tip: Watch the sounder for tight mid-water schools sitting 2-5m above deep reef pinnacles. Avoid lifting too aggressively.

species.name: Coral Trout
species.bagLimit: 7 fish per person (Part of Coral Reef Fin Fish quota of 20)
species.rodReel: 50 lb Heavy Overhead or 6000 Heavy Spin with fast lock-up drag
species.rig: Heavy bottom-bouncing paternoster or running ball sinker right down to 7/0 circle hook
species.baits: Live yellowtail scad, whole fresh squid, lively slimy mackerel
species.spots: Outer Gneerings: Big bommies and caves. Murphy's Reef: Broken rubble reef structure.
species.tip: Turn their head immediately in the first 3 seconds of hookup before they reef you. (Note: QLD seasonal closures only apply north of 24°50'S).

species.name: Venus Tuskfish (Parrot)
species.rodReel: 30-50 lb Spin or Overhead boat rod
species.rig: Paternoster rig with two strong 4/0 2X hooks
species.baits: Crab halves, live saltwater yabbies, fresh rock oysters, octopus tentacle
species.spots: Murphy's Reef: Gravel beds and coral edges. Caloundra Wide: Hard bottom gravel bars.
species.tip: Their strong parrot-like teeth crush soft hooks. Use forged heavy gauge hooks and crab bait.

species.name: Blackbanded Tuskfish
species.rig: Two-hook paternoster rig with 4/0 forged beak hooks
species.baits: Fresh crab pieces, mantis shrimp, peeled prawn, squid
species.spots: Outer Gneerings bommies: 25-35m depth. Murphy's Reef gravel patches.
species.tip: Stiff rod helps detect their rapid pecking bites before they strip crab bait clean.

species.name: Blackspot Pigfish
species.bagLimit: 5 fish per person (Part of Coral Reef Fin Fish quota of 20)
species.rodReel: 30-40 lb Spin or Overhead boat rod
species.rig: Two-hook paternoster rig with 4/0 strong octopus hooks
species.baits: Squid strips, peeled prawns, crab pieces, pilchard fillets
species.spots: Murphy's Reef Rocky Ledges: Broken reef and rubble edges. Caloundra 12 Mile & Outer Gneerings: 30-50m reef.
species.tip: Prized eating wrasse relative; keep baits tight to rocky rubble patches alongside tuskfish.

species.name: Grass Sweetlip
species.rig: Running ball sinker directly on top of 3/0-4/0 hook
species.baits: Fresh squid strips, pilchard fillets, peeled banana prawns
species.spots: Inner Gneerings: Shallows and reef patches in 12m-20m depth. Bray Rock & Currimundi Reefs: Broken bottom.
species.tip: Sweetlip love low light. Fish early dusk or night tides on close inshore reef edges.

species.name: Spangled Emperor
species.rig: Strayline rig with 5/0 circle hook or 1oz sinking swimbait
species.baits: Whole squid, cuttlefish strips, live yellowtail scad, pilchards
species.spots: Outer Gneerings sand/coral edges: 22-38m depths. Murphy's Reef gravel gutters.
species.tip: Spangleds patrol sandy gutters running between reef bommies. Anchor up-current and float baits into gutters.

species.name: Redthroat Emperor
species.bagLimit: 5 fish per person (Part of Coral Reef Fin Fish quota of 20)
species.rig: Paternoster or lightly weighted running sinker rig with 5/0-6/0 circle hook
species.baits: Fresh squid strips, whole pilchards, bonito strips, live yakkas
species.spots: Murphy's Reef: Coral ledges and pressure edges. Outer Gneerings & Caloundra 12 Mile: 30-50m reef.
species.tip: Often suspend 1-3m above reef structure; work baits just off the bottom when marking arches on the sounder.

species.name: Red Emperor
species.rodReel: 50-80 lb Heavy Boat Combo or overhead winch rod
species.rig: Heavy two-hook paternoster rig with 7/0-8/0 circle hooks or snelled suicide hooks
species.baits: Large fresh squid mantle, whole slimy mackerel, mullet fillets with skin on
species.spots: Caloundra 12 Mile Outer Fringe: 55-65m deep wire weed and low profile rubble bars. Barwon Banks Western Edge.
species.tip: Pick glass-out winter/autumn days in the 520. Look for isolated low-profile rubble bumps rather than steep bommies.

species.name: Scarlet Seaperch (Large-mouth Nannygai)
species.bagLimit: 5 fish per person (Part of Coral Reef Fin Fish quota of 20)
species.rodReel: 30-50 lb Overhead or Slow Jigging Combo
species.rig: Two-hook paternoster rig with 6/0 circle hooks or 100-150g slow pitch jig
species.baits: Whole fresh squid, slimy mackerel fillets, bonito strips, live yakkas
species.spots: Caloundra 12 Mile Deep Rubble & Wrecks: 45-60m depth. Outer Gneerings Deep Fringe: Isolated gravel bumps.
species.tip: They school up off the bottom at dusk and night; if you hook one, drop straight back down onto the exact GPS mark.

species.name: Crimson Seaperch (Small-mouth Nannygai)
species.bagLimit: 5 fish per person (Part of Coral Reef Fin Fish quota of 20)
species.rodReel: 30-50 lb Overhead or Slow Jigging Combo
species.rig: Paternoster rig with 5/0-6/0 circle hooks or 80-130g slow fall jig
species.baits: Squid strips, pilchard fillets, strip baits, slow-pitch jigs
species.spots: Caloundra 12 Mile Gravel & Wire Weed: 45-60m flats. Murphy's Reef Outer Ledges: Low rubble patches.
species.tip: Use a release weight for undersized fish pulled from 45m+ to prevent barotrauma.

species.name: Moses Perch
species.rig: Paternoster rig or light running sinker rig with 1/0-2/0 hook
species.baits: Squid strips, peeled prawns, small whitebait, pilchard cubes
species.spots: Inner Gneerings: 12m-22m reef flats. Mooloolaba Harbour Entrance walls & Currimundi Reefs.
species.tip: Aggressive bottom feeders; frequent catch when drifting over inshore reefs targeting squire.

species.name: Stripey Seaperch (Stripey Snapper)
species.bagLimit: 5 fish per person (Part of Coral Reef Fin Fish quota of 20)
species.rig: Two-hook paternoster or light running ball sinker with 3/0-4/0 hook
species.baits: Squid strips, pilchard pieces, peeled prawns, 4" soft plastics
species.spots: Inner & Outer Gneerings: 15-32m coral rubble. Currimundi Reef & Murphy's Reef: Broken reef edges.
species.tip: Punch well above their weight and dive straight back into reef crevices; keep drag firm near structure.

species.name: Green Jobfish
species.bagLimit: 5 fish per person (Part of Coral Reef Fin Fish quota of 20)
species.rig: Lightly weighted strayline bait, 80-120g jig, or 5"-7" jerkshad
species.baits: Live yakkas, whole pilchards, fresh squid, fast-worked jigs and soft plastics
species.spots: Murphy's Reef Mid-Water Pinnacles: Pressure faces. Outer Gneerings: 25-40m bommies in warm current.
species.tip: Aggressive mid-water hunters that readily chase jigs and soft plastics cranked briskly up off the reef.

species.name: Rosy Jobfish (King Snapper)
species.bagLimit: 5 fish per person (Part of Coral Reef Fin Fish quota of 20)
species.rodReel: 30-50 lb Overhead or Slow Jigging Combo
species.rig: Two-hook paternoster rig with 5/0 circle hooks or 100-150g slow pitch jig
species.baits: Fresh squid strips, bonito fillets, slimy mackerel strips, slow-pitch jigs
species.spots: Caloundra 12 Mile Deep Drop-offs: 50-65m deep ledges. Caloundra Wide Shelf Edge: Deep current lines.
species.tip: Superior white table flesh; look for schools suspended 5-10m off deep outer ledges.

species.name: Teraglin (Geelbeck)
species.rodReel: 30-50 lb Boat rod or overhead reel
species.rig: Paternoster rig with two 4/0-5/0 circle hooks kept 1-2m off bottom
species.baits: Fresh squid strips, live yakkas, slimy mackerel fillets
species.spots: Caloundra 12 Mile: 45-60m deep reef patches. Murphy's Reef outer drops.
species.tip: Teraglin bite best after sunset or during cloudy overcast days. Look for mid-water schools suspended above bottom.

species.name: Cobia (Black Kingfish)
species.rig: Live bait bridle rig under balloon or slow drifted mid-water, 2oz bucktail jigs
species.baits: Live yellowtail scad, whole fresh squid, 2oz white/chartreuse bucktail jig
species.spots: Caloundra 12 Mile: High pinnacles. Outer Gneerings: High relief structures and navigational buoys.
species.tip: They frequently swim right up to the Sea Spirit transom out of curiosity. Have a bucktail jig rigged ready to pitch.

species.name: Yellowtail Kingfish
species.rig: Live yakka under balloon, downrigger clip, or 150-250g mechanical knife jig
species.baits: Live yellowtail scad, live slimy mackerel, whole live calamari squid
species.spots: Caloundra 12 Mile: Steep drop-offs and high relief pinnacles. Outer Gneerings: Deep pressure faces.
species.tip: Speed jigging or slow trolling live yakkas around deep pinnacles during winter mornings is prime.

species.name: Amberjack
species.bagLimit: Combined Seriola limit: 2 fish per person
species.rodReel: 50-80 lb Heavy Jigging setup, PE 4-6 rod
species.rig: 200-300g Knife jig worked fast, or live yakka weighted to the bottom
species.baits: Live slimy mackerel, live yakka, whole squid, speed knife jigs
species.spots: Caloundra 12 Mile: 50-65m reef peaks. Outer pinnacles off Mooloolaba.
species.tip: Brutal fighting power. Set your drag high and pump hard off the bottom to keep them out of structure.

species.name: Samson Fish
species.bagLimit: Combined Seriola limit: 2 fish per person
species.rodReel: 50 lb Jigging combo or heavy boat rod
species.rig: Heavy live bait rig or 150-250g vertical jig
species.baits: Live yakkas, live slimy mackerel, knife jigs
species.spots: Deep Reef Pinnacles: Caloundra 12 Mile deep ledges (50m+).
species.tip: Often school alongside amberjack; prepare for sustained vertical slugfests beneath the boat.

species.name: Maori Cod
species.bagLimit: Part of Coral Reef Fin Fish quota of 20
species.rig: Paternoster rig with 6/0 hooks or bottom bounce jig
species.baits: Squid, pilchard fillets, live yakkas
species.spots: Murphy's Reef: Deep broken rubble. Caloundra 12 Mile: Deep reef caves.
species.tip: Bottom huggers that rarely venture far from their cave; drop your sinker right to the seafloor.

species.name: Pink Hussar
species.bagLimit: Part of Coral Reef Fin Fish quota of 20
species.rig: Standard two-hook paternoster with 3/0 hooks
species.baits: Squid strips, pilchard cubes
species.spots: Outer Gneerings & Murphy's Reef: 25-45m bottom structure.
species.tip: Great table fish despite smaller size; also makes hardy live bait for Spanish mackerel.

species.name: Spanish Mackerel
species.bagLimit: 1 fish per person / 2 per boat (Max boat limit of 2)
species.closure: ⚠️ Southern East Coast Closure (south of 22°S): 1–21 Feb & 1–21 Mar annually
species.rodReel: Overhead Trolling Combo or 6000-8000 Fast Spin, 15-24kg rod
species.lineLeader: 30-50 lb Braid + 50 lb Mono + 12-18" of 38-44 lb Single Strand Wire
species.rig: Trolled chin-weighted garfish rig or deep-diving bibbed minnow (e.g. Rapala X-Rap Mag 20/30)
species.baits: Rigged garfish, live slimy mackerel, whole bonito, diving hardbodies
species.spots: Inner & Outer Gneerings: Current lines pushing over reef drop-offs. Fairway Beacon: Trolling around entrance shipping marker.
species.tip: Troll at 4-6 knots along the pressure wave where oceanic current pushes up against Gneerings reef face.

species.name: Spotted Mackerel
species.rig: Direct tied small chrome slug (20g-40g) or unweighted pillie on gangs
species.baits: 20g-35g Halco Twisty or Gillies chrome lures, small live whitebait, drifted pilchard
species.spots: Point Cartwright to Currimundi: Chopping schools in 12m-25m depths. Old Woman Island (Mudjimba): Inshore wash zones.
species.tip: Look for diving terns. Cut your motor 80 meters upwind and drift silently into casting range so you don't spook the school.

species.name: Longtail Tuna (Northern Bluefin)
species.bagLimit: Combined tuna limit: 2 fish per person
species.rodReel: 4000-5000 Fast Spin, 10-15kg rod with strong backbone
species.lineLeader: 30 lb Braid + 40-50 lb Clear Fluorocarbon (long 3-4m stealth leader)
species.rig: Small heavy metal casting slices or unweighted soft plastic jerkshads skipped across surface
species.baits: 25g-40g Maria Mucho Lucir, 5" jerkshads in white or glow, small live herring
species.spots: Mooloolaba Bay & Point Cartwright: Bust-ups in 10-25m water. Old Woman Island: Chasing microbait.
species.tip: Tuna have keen eyesight. Match the hatch exactly to the size of the tiny whitebait they are busting on.

species.name: Mackerel Tuna (Little Tunny)
species.bagLimit: Combined tuna limit: 2 fish per person
species.rig: 15g-30g chrome casting slug or small soft plastic skipped fast
species.baits: Small metal slices, soft plastics, trolled feathers
species.spots: Mooloolaba Bay Shallows: Inside Point Cartwright out to 25m line. Bray Rock.
species.tip: High sporting value and makes prime fresh bait strip/berley for Snapper at Murphy's Reef.

species.name: Striped Tuna (Skipjack)
species.rig: Small trolled feather/skirt lure (3"-4") or 20-30g chrome casting slug
species.baits: Small trolling skirts, chrome slices, micro stickbaits
species.spots: Point Cartwright to Outer Gneerings: Current lines and bird work. Mooloolaba Bay: Mixed in with mackerel tuna.
species.tip: Unbeatable offshore strip bait and berley for Snapper, Pearl Perch, and Emperors—bleed and ice down immediately.

species.name: Yellowfin Tuna
species.bagLimit: Combined tuna limit: 2 fish per person
species.rig: Stickbait casting, trolling skirts, or drifted live slime under balloon
species.baits: Live slimy mackerel, trolled skirted lures (6"-8"), diving plugs
species.spots: Caloundra Wide Drop-offs: 50m-80m blue water shelf. Offshore FADs (8-15 NM).
species.tip: Watch the water temperature gauge on the Sea Spirit 520; look for warm blue current pushes above 24°C.

species.name: Mahi Mahi (Dolphinfish)
species.rig: Unweighted whole pilchard floated on a 5/0 hook, or 5" skipping stickbait
species.baits: Live yakkas, whole fresh pilchards, surface poppers, skirts
species.spots: Offshore FADs: Government FADs located 8-15 NM off Mooloolaba. Floating flotsam / trap floats.
species.tip: Check modern FAD GPS coordinates published by QLD Fisheries. Approach up-current and cast tight to float structure.

species.name: Wahoo
species.lineLeader: 50 lb Braid + 80 lb Mono Wind-on + #7 Single Strand Wire
species.rig: High speed trolling skirts or deep bibless minnows (e.g. Nomad DTX Minnow)
species.baits: Trolled Hexhead skirts, rigged garfish or bonito, high speed lures at 8-12 knots
species.spots: Caloundra Wide Drop-off: 50m-80m shelf edge. Outer trench edges.
species.tip: Pick calm blue-water days for your 520. Wahoo love speed; troll between 7 and 10 knots along temperature breaks.

species.name: Black Marlin (Juvenile Inshore)
species.sizeLimit: No minimum legal size (Tag & release standard)
species.lineLeader: 30-50 lb Braid + 80-100 lb Fluorocarbon/Mono wind-on leader
species.rig: Skip-baited rigged garfish/slimy mackerel on 7/0-8/0 inline circle hook, or 6"-7" pushers
species.baits: Live slimy mackerel, live yellowtail scad, skip-baited garfish, small trolling skirts
species.spots: Outer Gneerings & Murphy's Reef: Bait balls in 25-45m water. Caloundra 12 Mile & Sunshine Coast FADs: Warm summer current edges.
species.tip: Juvenile blacks (15-40kg) patrol inshore reefs all summer; keep them boatside for photos and release without lifting aboard.

species.name: Sailfish
species.lineLeader: 30-50 lb Braid + 80-100 lb Monofilament wind-on leader
species.rig: Skip-baited rigged garfish with circle hook or small skirted trolling lure
species.baits: Trolled garfish, live slimy mackerel drifted under balloon, 6" skirts
species.spots: Caloundra Wide & Barwon Banks fringe: Warm summer current lines (35-65m depth). Offshore FAD outer grounds.
species.tip: Summer warm current pushes bring sailfish into 40-50m depth off Mooloolaba. Look for surface bait showering.

species.name: Rainbow Runner
species.rig: Small surface poppers, casting slices, or live bait drifted near floats
species.baits: Small metal lures, pilchard strips, live baitfish
species.spots: Sunshine Coast FADs: Milling below Mahi Mahi around marker buoys in summer.
species.tip: Super fast runners that strike small shiny lures worked right beside FAD floats.
